A '''lightspeed torpedo''', also referred to as a '''Galaxy Gun Missile''', was a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that could travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. It was the main weapon of the [[Galaxy Gun]] and was used to carry the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon's]] [[Particle disintegrator warhead|payload]] through hyperspace to its targets.

==Description==
Lightspeed torpedoes were massive, high-yield [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] outfitted with [[particle disintegrator warhead]]s. The projectiles were launched from the [[Galaxy Gun]], entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and emerging at precise coordinates virtually anywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Equipped with a fast [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that rivalled the speed of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']],<ref name="NEGWT" /> lightspeed torpedoes could travel from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Each missile was propelled by [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight ion thrusters]] alongside the hyperdrive, and included an integrated [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. Short-range defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], intended to defend the missile from enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], were controlled by a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]]. Powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating protected the missile from [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire.<ref name="EGWT" />

The tip of the missile was mounted with the particle disintegrator [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]], which was energized by the internal [[Power core/Legends|power core]] at the projectile neared its target.<ref name="EGWT" /> Once a missile impacted on the surface of a planet, the energized warhead detonated, triggering a series of nucleonic chain reactions that spread across world, relentlessly converting matter to energy, consuming everything in its path.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Lightspeed torpedoes were capable of operating at different power settings. While the torpedoes were known for their planet-destroying capability while at full power, the missiles were equally capable of selective strikes against [[City/Legends|cities]] or military bases while leaving the rest of the planet unscathed.<ref name="EGWT" />
